comparison.objective: Open a spill-resistant bottle by manipulating two restraints while keeping it upright; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record stabilizes a free bottle while releasing a safety loop and lid detent. Candidate maintains rail–jig alignment and support continuity during a precision slide.
comparison.success_condition: Record grades restraint/lid angles and invalidates excessive tilt, loss of support or force. Candidate grades complete transfer, all-ball retention and avoidance of gap, inclination, jam, contamination and impact.
comparison.reason: Latch release and upright stabilization are different from transferring a recirculating bearing over a support interface.
